result.instructions: Tools for SignRequest, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which documents are still waiting for a signature?"; "Who has not signed the supplier contract yet?"; "Send the NDA template to anna@example.com for signature.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes SignRequest data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run signrequest_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run signrequest_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run signrequest_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. signrequest_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: signrequest_list_documents
tools.title: List documents
tools.description: List documents of the team with status, signers state and signing log links. API: GET /documents/.

status.description: Document status code: co converting, ne new, se sent, vi viewed, si signed, do downloaded, sd signed and downloaded, ca cancelled, de declined, ec error converting, es error sending, xp expired.

external_id.description: Filter by your own external id.

signrequest__who.description: Filter by sender: m = me, mo = me and others, o = others.

user__email.description: Filter by the document owner email.

tools.name: signrequest_get_document
tools.title: Get a document
tools.description: Get one document by uuid: status, signrequest with all signers, signing log, attachments, and temporary download links (pdf). API: GET /documents/{uuid}/.

tools.name: signrequest_search_documents
tools.title: Search documents
tools.description: Search documents by free text, name, signer email or status. API: GET /documents-search/.

status.description: Document status code: co converting, ne new, se sent, vi viewed, si signed, do downloaded, sd signed and downloaded, ca cancelled, de declined, ec error converting, es error sending, xp expired.

who.description: Filter by sender: m = me, mo = me and others, o = others.

tools.name: signrequest_list_signrequests
tools.title: List signature requests
tools.description: List signature requests (the sent requests with their signers). API: GET /signrequests/.

who.description: Filter by sender: m = me, mo = me and others, o = others.

tools.name: signrequest_get_signrequest
tools.title: Get a signature request
tools.description: Get one signature request by uuid, with each signer's viewed, signed, declined and forwarded state. API: GET /signrequests/{uuid}/.

tools.name: signrequest_list_templates
tools.title: List templates
tools.description: List document templates (use a template uuid with signrequest_send_document). API: GET /templates/.

tools.name: signrequest_get_template
tools.title: Get a template
tools.description: Get one template by uuid, with its signer placeholders. API: GET /templates/{uuid}/.

tools.name: signrequest_list_teams
tools.title: List teams
tools.description: List the teams the token can see (name, subdomain, sandbox flag). API: GET /teams/.

tools.name: signrequest_get_team
tools.title: Get a team
tools.description: Get one team by subdomain. API: GET /teams/{subdomain}/.

tools.name: signrequest_list_team_members
tools.title: List team members
tools.description: List team members with admin, owner and active flags. API: GET /team-members/.

tools.name: signrequest_list_events
tools.title: List events
tools.description: List document events (sent, viewed, signed, declined, cancelled, bounced) and their callback delivery state. API: GET /events/.

document__uuid.description: Only events of this document uuid.

document__external_id.description: Only events of the document with this external id.

event_type.description: Event type, for example signed, declined, sent, signer_signed, signer_email_bounced.

tools.name: signrequest_send_document
tools.title: Send a document for signature
tools.description: WRITE: creates a document and e-mails a signature request to the signers right away (not undoable except with signrequest_cancel_signrequest). Give exactly one source: a template uuid, a public file_from_url, or base64 file_from_content with file_from_content_name. API: POST /signrequest-quick-create/.

needs_to_sign.description: false = the person only receives a copy (default true).

approve_only.description: true = the person approves instead of signing.

language.description: Signer language code, for example en, nl, de, fr.

from_email.description: Sender email (a verified team member address).

from_email_name.description: Sender name shown in the e-mail.

template.description: Template API url or uuid-based url from signrequest_list_templates (the url field).

file_from_url.description: Public https URL of the file to sign.

file_from_content_name.description: File name with extension for file_from_content.

who.description: Who signs: m = me, mo = me and others, o = others.

tools.name: signrequest_cancel_signrequest
tools.title: Cancel a signature request
tools.description: WRITE: cancels a signature request that is not fully signed or declined. Signers who have not signed can no longer open the document. Not undoable. API: POST /signrequests/{uuid}/cancel_signrequest/.

tools.name: signrequest_resend_signrequest_email
tools.title: Resend signature request e-mail
tools.description: WRITE: sends the signature request e-mail again as a reminder to every signer who did not sign yet but already got the e-mail. API: POST /signrequests/{uuid}/resend_signrequest_email/.
